1.web: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
1.asv: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness; Thou hast set me at large when I was in distress: Have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

2.web: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity, and seek after falsehood? Selah.
2.asv: O ye sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? How longwill ye love vanity, and seek after falsehood? [Selah

3.web: But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly: Yahweh will hear when I call to him.
3.asv: But know that Jehovah hath set apart for himself him that is godly: Jehovah will hear when I call unto him.

4.web: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.
4.asv: Stand in awe, and sin not: Commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. [Selah

5.web: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in Yahweh.
5.asv: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And put your trust in Jehovah.

6.web: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
6.asv: Many there are that say, Who will show us any good? Jehovah, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

7.web: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
7.asv: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, More thanthey havewhen their grain and their new wine are increased.

8.web: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.
8.asv: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; For thou, Jehovah, alone makest me dwell in safety.
